findings.summary: BadgeSelectorResolver.IsAllowed trims the candidate but not the supplied allowlist entries; the production path is correct because BadgeDefinition trims every entry at construction.
findings.detail: IsAllowed trims only the candidate and compares against allowedValues verbatim. ADR-017 clause 5 requires the configured entries to be trimmed, and the only production caller (BadgeDefinitionResolver.Resolve via RendererConfigurationResolver.ResolveDefinitions) passes BadgeDefinition.AllowedValues, which NormalizeAllowedValues builds as a trimmed immutable copy. A direct external caller passing untrimmed entries would not match, but no such caller exists. Carries forward unchanged.

findings.summary: The committed goldens are unmodified but were not executed in this environment (native Skia unavailable), so 'goldens pass unchanged' is inferred rather than run.
findings.detail: tests/ArrTags.Tests/Goldens/ is clean and the default suite reports the same 63 skips as baseline (no new skips). Golden/cross-runtime facts are skipped without ARRTAGS_SKIA_COMPAT=1, and forcing that variable fails with a native SkiaSharp.SKColorSpace.CreateSrgb() failure in this environment. The default configuration has an empty allowlist, which IsAllowed treats as no restriction and which the task 12.1 fingerprint work treats as identity-neutral, so rendered output is unchanged by construction. Task 12.4 owns golden regeneration/execution; task 14.3 owns the live-host run.

acceptance_criteria_assessment.a_configured_allowlist_restricts_renderi: MET. BadgeDefinitionResolver.Resolve filters each resolved pre-template value.Text through BadgeSelectorResolver.IsAllowed(value.Text, definition.AllowedValues) before applying the template. BadgeAllowlistFilterTests asserts retention and suppression. Implementation unchanged from the attempt-1 review.
acceptance_criteria_assessment.unknown_and_absent_values_remain_omitted: MET. Unknown/absent values are never emitted by BadgeSelectorResolver.Resolve, and IsAllowed only removes already-confirmed values. UnknownAndAbsentValuesRemainOmittedWithAnAllowlist asserts an empty selection even with a non-empty allowlist.
acceptance_criteria_assessment.an_empty_allowlist_means_no_restriction: MET. IsAllowed returns true immediately when allowedValues.Count == 0; BadgeDefinition normalizes null/empty to an empty read-only list. EmptyAllowlistMeansNoRestriction asserts the behavior; BadgeDefinition.V1Default carries empty allowlists.
acceptance_criteria_assessment.match_semantics_exact_case_insensitive_o: MET. string.Equals(candidate, allowed, StringComparison.OrdinalIgnoreCase) after value.Trim(); configured entries are trimmed at construction. AllowlistRequiresAnExactCaseInsensitiveMatch and IsAllowedTrimsTheResolvedValueAndRejectsPartialMatches assert no substring/prefix/wildcard/regex path.
acceptance_criteria_assessment.filter_before_template_order: MET. The filter uses the pre-template value; FilterIsAppliedBeforeTheDefinitionTemplate shows an allowlist naming the templated text filters the value out while an allowlist naming the pre-template value retains it and then applies the template.
acceptance_criteria_assessment.per_custom_value_and_full_audio_composit: MET. One BadgeValue per retained custom badge (filtered independently); the full Audio composite (Atmos/TrueHD/8) matches while a component alone does not; the fixed UpgradePending status text is filtered and can be suppressed.
acceptance_criteria_assessment.allowlisted_but_unfittable_still_shorten: MET. The filter runs before BadgeLayoutEngine.Build; AnAllowlistedValueThatCannotFitStillFollowsTheOmitBehavior asserts an allowlisted custom value is omitted when it cannot fit.
